content.text: In Nigeria, where Stripe and PayPal are severely restricted, digital creators face a common infrastructure problem: automated digital product delivery with crypto payments. What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation is a backend logic solution that enables automated digital product delivery with crypto payments. This means you can configure your store to send download links to customers automatically after a payment confirms on-chain, without relying on third-party platforms. This architecture is critical for creators in restricted markets, like Nigeria, where access to Stripe and PayPal is severely limited.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of Google Apps Script as the backend logic, which interacts with NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers the Google Apps Script to retrieve the order details and send a download link to the customer via Resend or Gmail. This process ensures seamless and automated order fulfillment, even in the absence of conventional payment platforms.

How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment amount and transaction hash from the payload, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, generates a receipt, creates a time-limited download link for the product file, and sends the delivery email. The entire sequence completes in under 30 seconds from payment confirmation in almost all cases. Nothing in this sequence requires your presence, your attention, or any manual action.
